subject: Dropped class, charge, and portal access all at once
message: Hi, I have a few things going on and I'm not sure who to ask. First, I dropped my statistics class in week three because of a scheduling conflict with my new job, and I still see the full tuition charge on my account. I thought dropping in week three got me at least part of the money back. Second, ever since I dropped it, the student portal keeps kicking me back to the login screen with an error code and I can't get into Canvas to check my other grades, so I also need my official transcript request to go through before a scholarship deadline on Friday. Finally, could you tell me what software I can install for free on my own laptop, because the lab closes at 9pm and I do most of my work after that? Sorry for the long message, I just wanted to get everything into one email.
